page_title: TOR 2-2 INT | Torino v Inter 26/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' The statistic for corner kicks – 5:5. The fouls committed statistics – 9:8.
90+5' The resulting corner from Rafael Obrador (Torino) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

90+4' Alieu Njie (Torino) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. Torino will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
90+3' Andy Diouf (Inter) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alberto Paleari, who smothers the ball.
90+2' Marcus Thuram (Inter) produces a long-range strike, but he only hits one of his own teammates standing in its way.
90+1' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Adrien Tameze (Torino) replaces Giovanni Simeone.
89' Nicolo Barella (Inter) launches a cross from the corner, but Alberto Paleari is alert to thwart the effort.

88' Davide Frattesi (Inter) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Inter will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
87' Substitution. Yann Bisseck walks off the pitch and Davide Frattesi (Inter) comes on as a substitute.
86' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Nicolo Barella (Inter) was quite harsh and Maurizio Mariani didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
85' Enzo Ebosse (Torino) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
85' Duvan Zapata (Torino) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
84' Andy Diouf (Inter) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
83' A goal, which was scored by Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter), was disallowed due to offside.
83' Cesare Casadei (Torino) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him.
81' Referee Maurizio Mariani halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Roberto D'Aversa, then shows him a yellow.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Andy Diouf (Inter) replaces Federico Dimarco.
80' Cristian Chivu prepares a substitution. Matteo Darmian is replaced by Denzel Dumfries (Inter).
80' Substitution. Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Petar Sucic walks off.
79' 2 - 2 Goal! Nikola Vlasic (Torino) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Yann Sommer into the top left corner.
79' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
78' The Torino players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
76' There's a break in play and referee Maurizio Mariani must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Torino using VAR. This could be interesting!
75' Rafael Obrador (Torino) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Torino force a corner. They send men into the box.
75' Alieu Njie (Torino) gets on the end of a pass and produces a promising first-time shot towards the right side of the goal. His effort is blocked by Yann Sommer with a brilliant diving save!
75' Carlos Augusto (Inter) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
74' The resulting corner from Rafael Obrador (Torino) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
73' The ball is cleared after Duvan Zapata (Torino) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out for a corner. Torino can continue in their attacking effort.
72' Luca Marianucci tees up Giovanni Simeone (Torino) with a precision cross. He holds off the defender, but fires his shot just wide of the left post.
72' 6:12 – the total goal attempt statistics. The shots on goal statistics – 1:5.
72' Duvan Zapata (Torino) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Giovanni Simeone, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.
70' 1 - 2 GOAL - 1:2! Emirhan Ilkhan found Giovanni Simeone (Torino) inside the box, he spotted goalkeeper Yann Sommer off his line and chipped the ball into the net. What a cheeky lob!
70' Emirhan Ilkhan (Torino) sends a long ball in, but Yann Sommer comfortably gathers the ball.
67' Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
67' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Duvan Zapata (Torino) replacing Che Adams.
67' That will be all from Gvidas Gineitis who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Cesare Casadei (Torino).
64' Marcus Thuram (Inter) sends a cross into the box, but Alberto Paleari comes off his line to gather the ball.

61' 0 - 2 Yann Bisseck (Inter) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Federico Dimarco. His header went in off the right post, giving the goalkeeper no chance. It's 0:2.
61' Federico Dimarco (Inter) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
61' Substitution. Ange-Yoan Bonny leaves the pitch and is replaced by Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter).
60' Marcus Thuram (Inter) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. The ball is out of play. Inter will have a chance to score from a corner.
59' Federico Dimarco (Inter) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
57' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
57' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Rafael Obrador (Torino), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
57' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) decides to have a shot at goal from the free kick, but it hits the defensive wall. The ball is out of play and Torino manage to earn a corner.
56' Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for a foul after Petar Sucic (Inter) hacks down one of his opponents. Torino win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
54' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alieu Njie (Torino) will replace Valentino Lazaro.
53' Roberto D'Aversa decides to make a substitution. Saul Coco will be replaced by Luca Marianucci (Torino).
52' The game is interrupted as Giovanni Simeone (Torino) is flagged offside.
51' A pass into the penalty area from Rafael Obrador (Torino) is intercepted by the defence.
51' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
50' Nicolo Barella (Inter) tries to find Federico Dimarco, but he puts too much power on the pass.
49' The game is interrupted now, Valentino Lazaro (Torino) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
48' Matteo Darmian (Inter) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
47' Federico Dimarco (Inter) picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and directs a sweet strike towards the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper, however, denies him with a stunning save.
46' Referee Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' Enzo Ebosse (Torino) picks out Emirhan Ilkhan with a fine lofted pass, but the latter wasn't able to create some space to get into shooting range.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
43' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) latches on to a fine cross from the resulting corner and attempts to finish from the edge of the box. His shot, however, misses the target narrowly wide of the left post.
43' The referee awards a corner and Federico Dimarco (Inter) goes over to take it.
42' Petar Sucic (Inter) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee blows his whistle, Inter are awarded a corner kick.
41' Rafael Obrador (Torino) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
41' A cross from Valentino Lazaro (Torino) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. Torino force their opponents to concede a corner.
40' Marcus Thuram (Inter) attempts to find Piotr Zielinski with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
39' Ardian Ismajli (Torino) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
37' Che Adams (Torino) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
35' Matteo Darmian (Inter) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
33' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) anticipates the cross from Petar Sucic, but powers his header way over the bar from the edge of the six-yard box.
31' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 2:5. 0:3 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
29' Inter are seeing far more of the ball now.
27' Petar Sucic (Inter) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alberto Paleari intercepts the ball.

23' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Marcus Thuram (Inter) makes it 0:1. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Federico Dimarco and planted his close-range header into the top of the net. Alberto Paleari was helpless.
21' Emirhan Ilkhan (Torino) attempts to find Giovanni Simeone, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
20' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
19' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) sprays a pass out to Gvidas Gineitis, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
17' The percentage of ball possession is – 32:68.

14' Alberto Paleari pulls off a decent save! Yann Bisseck (Inter) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the middle of the net, but the effort is kept out.
12' Carlos Augusto (Inter) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
12' Nicolo Barella (Inter) will take the corner.
11' Marcus Thuram (Inter) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. Corner kick. Inter will have an opportunity.
10' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
8' Nikola Vlasic releases Saul Coco (Torino) with a pass, he composes himself and shoots from mid-range but the ball curls well wide of the right post.
7' A dangerous towering header by Manuel Akanji (Inter) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the right post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
7' Nicolo Barella (Inter) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
6' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play and Inter have been awarded a corner kick.
5' Manuel Akanji (Inter) sends a long cross over to Marcus Thuram, but Alberto Paleari comes forward to gather the ball.
4' Inter keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
2' Rafael Obrador (Torino) takes a short corner kick.

1' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. The linesman makes the right call and Torino will have a corner.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
